summary: Implemented the window title feature without running tests, mypy, or Black. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry producing ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, plus the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise, with the required docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a PR 2200 bullet. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (sequence assertion skipped when legacy_windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and a Windows-only test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was committed. Verification was by reading only.
